compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)

pin_diff.note: PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 1: AP2210N-3.3TRG1 assigns GND (GND) whereas LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB assigns OUT (VOUT) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 2: AP2210N-3.3TRG1 assigns VOUT (VOUT) whereas LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB assigns IN (VIN) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 3: AP2210N-3.3TRG1 assigns VIN (VIN) whereas LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB assigns GND (GND) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.

parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_b_value: Ceramic OK · >=0.1 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (GND vs VOUT), Pin 2 (VOUT vs VIN), Pin 3 (VIN vs GND). Soldering LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB onto a AP2210N-3.3TRG1 footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.

CRITICAL CAPACITOR ESR OSCILLATION RISK: LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB is stable with low-ESR ceramic MLCCs (>= 0.1 µF, p.11), whereas AP2210N-3.3TRG1 is NOT ceramic-cap stable (ESR window: 0.025–15 Ω (p.22)). Using an ultra-low-ESR MLCC on AP2210N-3.3TRG1 can trigger control-loop oscillation.
CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs by 10x (AP2210N-3.3TRG1: 1 µF p.23 vs LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB: 0.1 µF p.11); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: AP2210N-3.3TRG1 is rated to only 13.2 V rec. (15 V abs max, p.4) vs LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB at 30 V rec. (35 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB supplies up to 100 mA (p.5) compared to AP2210N-3.3TRG1 at 300 mA (p.1); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
CAUTION DROPOUT HEADROOM: Typical dropout differs (AP2210N-3.3TRG1: 250 mV p.11 vs LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB: 900 mV p.5); verify Vin,min - Vout >= Vdo across temperature and load corners.

HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: AP2210N-3.3TRG1 has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (15 V, p.4) than LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB (35 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 15 V.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 35% higher on LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB (AP2210N-3.3TRG1: 200 °C/W p.4 vs LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB: 269.6 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB requires Vin,min >= 4.8 V (p.5) vs 2.5 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AP2210N-3.3TRG1: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to +85°C ambient; -40°C to +125°C TJ) vs LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB: -40..125 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ)); AP2210N-3.3TRG1 hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: AP2210N-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-3) and LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-3) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (GND vs VOUT), Pin 2 (VOUT vs VIN), Pin 3 (VIN vs GND). Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (GND vs VOUT), Pin 2 (VOUT vs VIN), Pin 3 (VIN vs GND). Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 100 mA (170 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 34 °C on AP2210N-3.3TRG1 (θJA 200 °C/W) vs 45.8 °C on LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB (θJA 269.6 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 20x ratio (100 µA (p.11) vs 2000 µA (p.5)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP2210N-3.3TRG1 "SOT-23-3 Pinout (1=GND, 2=VOUT, 3=VIN) Reversed vs AP7333-SA, AP7313-SA, and LM3480" (p.1) and LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB "Unique SOT-23-3 Pinout (1=OUT, 2=IN, 3=GND) Incompatible With ALL Other SOT-23-3 LDOs in Batch" (p.3). BOM decision: Choose AP2210N-3.3TRG1 when load current exceeds 100 mA (up to 300 mA) or battery sleep budget demands 100 µA Iq; choose LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB when input rails climb above 13.2 V (rated to 30 V) or your BOM standardizes on low-ESR MLCC ceramic output capacitors. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
